summary.summary: Five scenarios failed due to data mismatches and validation gaps. History rows show zero change instead of actual amounts, and date‑boundary filtering omits expected transactions. Transfer endpoint incorrectly accepts overdraft, negative, and zero amounts, creating records and altering balances. These indicate missing validation and incorrect display logic.

fixes.HIS-ROWS: Row rendering uses placeholder 'No change' instead of actual amount; map record amount to UI field.
fixes.HIS-DATE-BOUNDARY: Date filter excludes edge‑case timestamps; treat start/end as inclusive with proper timezone conversion.
fixes.TRF-OVERDRAFT: Transfer service lacks overdraft check; enforce balance >= amount before processing.
fixes.TRF-AMT-NEG: Negative amount not validated; reject amounts <=0 with error response.
fixes.TRF-AMT-ZERO: Zero amount not validated; reject and do not create transaction record.
fixes.TRF-AMT-ZERO2: Same as TRF-AMT-ZERO – ensure zero‑value transfers are blocked.
